subject.title: fix: Google invalid keys no longer stop model fallback

question: After a current-base refresh, should the repository adopt this broader shared invalid-API-key matcher for all provider fallback paths?
rationale: The change intentionally broadens a cross-provider authentication classification boundary, and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label despite strong focused proof.

options.title: Merge after refresh
options.body: Rebase or refresh the branch against current `main`, then merge if the focused matcher and embedded-result fallback coverage still passes.

options.title: Keep the narrower prior behavior
options.body: Decline the broader matcher if maintainers prefer provider-specific handling for the additional invalid-key variants.

recommendation.title: Merge after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh the branch against current `main`, then merge if the focused matcher and embedded-result fallback coverage still passes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged predecessor that established the Google invalid-key fallback behavior and are the closest evidenced feature-history contact.
